codeReview.summary: The redesign adds grouped date sections, left-strip cards, a search/filter panel, and a rounded-square FAB, but it does not fully satisfy the filter-chip contract and introduces a locale-specific date header implementation.

issues.description: Selected category filter chips use each category color as the active background/border (`chipColor`). The feature contract and VAL-LOGS-002 require active chips to use the primary background with white text while keeping the category represented only by the small colored dot. As implemented, selected chips render in irrigation/spray/harvest/expense/fertigation colors instead of the primary token.

Date group headers are formatted with `toLocaleDateString('en-GB', ...)`, which hardcodes English month names and bypasses the screen's existing locale-aware date formatting path (`formatDate` is still used later in the file at line 1266). The mission explicitly required preserving i18n, so these new headers will not follow non-English locales.

summary: Reviewed commit `d8230f5` and the worker transcript for `logs-redesign`.
